note: lr is calibrated once on the intact circuit and held fixed. The fractional memory_paired_MBON11 drop is calibration-locked under the binary code (~target when any trained KC->MBON11 edge survives, else None), so it CANNOT express graded impairment. Graded memory measure: drive_loss_vs_intact (untrained MBON11 drive to A lost to the lesion; not applicable to APL_disinhibited, where a dense code RAISES that drive). Behavioural readout: learned_shift = avoid_A_after - avoid_A_before, and its fraction of the intact shift. avoid_A_before is lesion-specific (the readout is normalised per lesioned circuit), so avoid_A_after alone must NOT be compared with 0.5; learned_shift ~0 = no learned avoidance. Rows with independent_wiring_test false are identities of the rule or readout given the dopamine->MBON compartment map, and cannot fail.
